name: Doom
what: The famous fast shooter from 1993, still played and modded every day.

fanProjects.name: Freedoom
fanProjects.what: Free levels, art and sounds that work with Doom engines. With it, you need nothing else to play.
howToPlay: Play it with a free engine like UZDoom.

fanProjects.name: UZDoom
fanProjects.what: A free modern Doom engine with better graphics and mouse controls. Use your own Doom files or Freedoom.
howToPlay: Put your Doom or Freedoom file (a .wad file) next to it and start.

lovedFeatures: Mazes with keys and secret doors
Different enemies with their own moves
scopeNote: Our builder makes 2D games best. For a first-person game, start from the released Doom code or a free engine instead.
legalNote: Violent games are fine to make, but keep your own monsters, art and level maps.
